notes: The school text calls the total number of objects the denominator in one step. The app corrects this: the denominator is the number of equal groups in the fraction being found.
One school diagram shows five squares but labels six. The app counts actual cells.
The red triangle has an unknown side without equality marks. The app does not assume that side length.
